caption: The drawing depicts a single flowerpot with a matching saucer underneath it, both centered on a plain light beige or off-white background. The flowerpot is cylindrical, wider at the top, and features a reddish-brown rim. The outer surface of the pot has a cream base color with irregular patterns in dark green, brown, and light blue, forming abstract shapes and streaks. The inside of the pot is shaded in tones of brown and ochre. The saucer at the base is similarly colored in cream with hints of brownish-pink along the rim, and it has faint greenish and brown spots, matching the style of the flowerpot. There are no other objects or decorations present in the image.
